Boundaries.Name: native-pooled-inspection
Boundaries.Contract: Raw pooled GetResult observes final transport/server inspection only when explicitly enabled. Borrowed raw inspection remains unobserved. A transferred failure-only FinalOwner survives caller reference release and pool reset; publication occurs after cleanup. Keep token checks and response ownership intact.

Boundaries.Name: typed-converter-inspection
Boundaries.Contract: Converted pooled GetResult keeps its optional failure-only FinalOwner through transport inspection, converter invocation, response disposal and caller reference release. Existing dispatch publication defaults and copied retry counts remain intact. Publish once after cleanup using local lease and attempt copies so pool reuse cannot change retries. Borrowed conversion suppresses publication.

Boundaries.Name: string-result-inspection
Boundaries.Contract: String inspection owns transport, cancellation, server and conversion failures through response cleanup and caller reference release. Existing dispatch publication defaults and copied retry counts remain intact. Retain the operation until a canceled receive reference drains; successful inspection rents no observation.
